summary: Six refusals reachable before a verb's own logging reach the operator unstamped, so a `flume loop` or `flume tick` that takes one writes the only line of its run with no instant

per.section: A log line carries the instant it was written

acceptance: every operator line a `flume tick` or `flume loop` process writes carries its instant, the refusals it can take before reaching its own logger included — stamped at each site rather than under a branch on which verb is running, since each is stderr and no verb's piped stdout is touched; the refusal text after the stamp, and every exit code, are unchanged
tests: flume loop refused at state-root resolution stamps the refusal with the instant it was written
flume tick refused at bay discovery stamps the refusal with the instant it was written
